title: Identify the EUR battle OBJ list producer
changes: Identify the ordinary producer of the previously observed 40dcba battle list as a relative-directory lookup followed by a write to the live task slot.
validation: Wine battle-writer-observer-wine-q7qbukus follows one retained neutral-input continuation with a width/value-unfiltered watch on the task slot. It observes an initial clear, then 0800720c with directory 0840d300 and selector 62, followed by original 0802e110 writing 0840dcba to task+24. Matching pre-resolver and pre-writer states are retained privately.
Static EUR inspection identifies a kind-2 directory with 103 entries; selector 62 resolves through relative offset 09b6. The accepted three-frame E147 battle pair remains unchanged.
limitations: The watch captures the first overlapping bus access per step and its pre-step PC can include nested work. Other directory selectors and consumers, original entry payloads, frontend UI, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
